intro.text: A fictional ronin in the historical drama Seasons of Regret, a hion viewer program.

items.text: Sir Ashinata, a wandering warrior drawn in blue hion lines who carries a hion blade, is forbidden to be with Lady Hinobi, the woman he loves.
After he and Hinobi first kissed, Ashinata said he must leave her forever because of a danger his late, wicked brother had set in motion. A surprise final episode brought him back to her.
